summary: Modern two bedroom flat · Great location for A19 & A1 · Furnished · Allocated Parking · Available July 2024
description:
A modern two bedroom flat in a quiet yet convenient Fencehouses location.

My Property Box are pleased to present to the Lettings market this modern two bedroom ground floor apartment at Sidings Place. Situated in a quiet, modern development the property offer great sized rooms throughout and is finished to a high standard. Two great sized bedrooms, large open-plan living room / kitchen and central bathroom. Large windows with tasteful venetian blinds provide a light & airy feel throughout the flat. Off-street parking provided with great access to the A19 & A1 motorways. Ideal for those who desire a secure & peaceful flat.

Available mid-July, unfurnished.

To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak with the Lettings Team.
